# rexmi_dog — visual reskin asset

Same kinematics / joint names / physics as `../go2w`, with replaceable visuals.

## Do not edit by hand (unless you know why)

- `urdf/go2w/configuration/go2w_physics.usd` — frozen from Go2W
- `urdf/go2w/configuration/go2w_robot.usd` — frozen from Go2W
- `urdf/go2w/configuration/go2w_sensor.usd` — frozen from Go2W
- `_frozen_original_usd/` — backup of the above + original base

## Replaceable

- `meshes/` — filled by `scripts/apply_visual_reskin.py` from SolidWorks drop-off
- `urdf/go2w.urdf` — visual mesh paths only (regenerated by apply script)
- `urdf/go2w/configuration/go2w_base.usd` — visual layer (updated on apply/convert)

## Enable

```bash
export REXMI_ROBOT_VISUAL=rexmi_dog
```

See `../visual_reskin/MANIFEST.md`.
